encounters.name: Aggressor
encounters.description: Someone is threatening another and appears ready to hurt them.

encounters.name: Ailing
encounters.description: An animal is suffering from an illness or injury that needs treatment.

encounters.name: Ambusher
encounters.description: Careful observation may expose someone lying concealed, ready to strike.

encounters.name: Arcanum
encounters.description: A magical object reveals itself only when you sense and read its arcane presence.

encounters.name: Audience
encounters.description: Someone - or a gathered group - offers an opportunity to gain something by performing for them.

encounters.name: Beast
encounters.description: A dangerous animal attacks or stands violently in your way.

encounters.name: Blighted
encounters.description: Someone is afflicted by a supernatural malady that must be understood before they can be helped.

encounters.name: Brigand
encounters.description: A hostile person confronts you and intends violence.

encounters.name: Burden
encounters.description: Someone is pinned or trapped beneath something that must be physically moved.

encounters.name: Cache
encounters.description: You uncover a concealed store of useful equipment.

encounters.name: Captor
encounters.description: Someone holds another person against their will.

encounters.name: Carcass
encounters.description: Signs in the wild lead you to the remains of a dead animal.

encounters.name: Carrion
encounters.description: The decaying remains of an animal make the way ahead feel distinctly ill-favoured.

encounters.name: Climb
encounters.description: What you seek lies above or below, requiring strength and athleticism to reach.

encounters.name: Contraption
encounters.description: A small but consequential contraption can be altered through precise tampering.

encounters.name: Control
encounters.description: An ongoing hazard is governed by a device whose workings can be discovered and shut down.

encounters.name: Crypt
encounters.description: Careful examination reveals a concealed way into or through an enclosed place.

encounters.name: Cursed
encounters.description: An animal suffers beneath a supernatural affliction that must be understood to save it.

encounters.name: Discovery
encounters.description: Careful observation may reveal something remarkable that would otherwise go unnoticed.

encounters.name: Dispute
encounters.description: Two sides are at odds and must be persuaded or intimidated into yielding.

encounters.name: Distortion
encounters.description: Something supernatural has made the surrounding space difficult to navigate normally.

encounters.name: Enforcer
encounters.description: Someone confronts you, intent on taking either you or something in your possession.

encounters.name: Engine
encounters.description: A functioning machine or system can be sabotaged by understanding how it works.

encounters.name: Feral
encounters.description: An animal's wild behaviour must be changed before it can be dealt with safely.

encounters.name: Footing
encounters.description: The way forward crosses precarious ground where balance and agility matter.

encounters.name: Gambler
encounters.description: Someone offers an opportunity to gain something by staking it on a game or wager.

encounters.name: Gatekeeper
encounters.description: Someone controls your access and must be deceived into allowing you through.

encounters.name: Gauntlet
encounters.description: The way through demands a sequence of agile physical manoeuvres.

encounters.name: Grim
encounters.description: An ominous animal appears, and its presence fills you with foreboding.

encounters.name: Guardian
encounters.description: A benevolent animal appears whose presence makes your situation feel safer.

encounters.name: Guide
encounters.description: An animal's behaviour shows you a useful way forward.

encounters.name: Gull
encounters.description: Someone can be deceived into surrendering something you need.

encounters.name: Harbinger
encounters.description: Someone brings news or signs that leave you expecting trouble ahead.

encounters.name: Haunt
encounters.description: A place is troubled by a supernatural presence that arcane understanding may lay to rest.

encounters.name: Herald
encounters.description: Someone brings welcome news or signs that strengthen your resolve.

encounters.name: Holdout
encounters.description: Someone doesn't seem inclined toward the change you want, but might be convinced or deceived.

encounters.name: Hollow
encounters.description: Your knowledge of the natural world reveals a secluded space hidden within the landscape.

encounters.name: Hostile
encounters.description: An aggressive animal threatens someone who needs your protection.

encounters.name: Kindred
encounters.description: An animal shows signs that a bond of trust could be formed with it.

encounters.name: Mark
encounters.description: Someone possesses something that might be useful to you and presents an opportunity to take it through deception or intimidation.

encounters.name: Mechanism
encounters.description: A mechanism bars the way, but understanding its workings may let you pass.

encounters.name: Nook
encounters.description: Careful observation may reveal a small, easily overlooked place.

encounters.name: Obstruction
encounters.description: A physical obstacle blocks the way and must be forced aside or overcome.

encounters.name: Omen
encounters.description: From here you can see another place ahead bearing a discouraging sign - distant storm clouds, black smoke, or something similarly foreboding.

encounters.name: Passage
encounters.description: Careful observation may reveal a way through the surrounding place.

encounters.name: Predator
encounters.description: A hunting animal threatens pursuit, but might be escaped through a convincing pretense.

encounters.name: Prowler
encounters.description: An animal moves nearby without yet noticing you, leaving you a chance to slip past unseen.

encounters.name: Quarry
encounters.description: Signs in the natural world reveal an animal worth tracking down.

encounters.name: Reach
encounters.description: What you seek lies somewhere awkward or precarious to access.

encounters.name: Refuge
encounters.description: You find a sheltered place where you can safely recover your strength and resolve.

encounters.name: Resistant
encounters.description: Someone is refusing to cooperate with the delivery and must be persuaded or intimidated into doing so.

encounters.name: Resource
encounters.description: The natural world offers useful supplies that can be gathered.

encounters.name: Restraint
encounters.description: Someone is bound by a restraint that careful, dexterous manipulation can defeat.

encounters.name: Safe
encounters.description: Something you need is secured against easy access and must be deftly retrieved.

encounters.name: Separation
encounters.description: Someone has become physically cut off from safety and must be reached.

encounters.name: Snare
encounters.description: Someone is caught in a contrivance whose workings must be understood to free them.

encounters.name: Sovereign
encounters.description: An object with a will of its own may be persuaded or intimidated into becoming yours.

encounters.name: Stalker
encounters.description: An animal is closing in unseen, preparing to ambush you if you fail to notice it.

encounters.name: Stranding
encounters.description: Someone is trapped somewhere they cannot leave without agile assistance.

encounters.name: Stricken
encounters.description: Someone suffers from an illness or injury that needs treatment.

encounters.name: Sullen
encounters.description: An object with a will of its own refuses to cooperate and must somehow be won over.

encounters.name: Support
encounters.description: Something larger depends upon a physical support that can be broken, shifted or removed.

encounters.name: Terrain
encounters.description: Difficult terrain makes progress dependent upon physical exertion.

encounters.name: Thief
encounters.description: A fleeting glimpse may reveal someone escaping with something stolen from you, while pursuit is still possible.

encounters.name: Threshold
encounters.description: A magical doorway or boundary will permit passage only if you can establish the right arcane connection with it.

encounters.name: Trader
encounters.description: Someone offers an exchange, with an opportunity to haggle the trade in your favour.

encounters.name: Trap
encounters.description: Careful observation may reveal a concealed danger before it catches someone.

encounters.name: Trigger
encounters.description: A dangerous mechanism can be neutralized through precise manipulation.

encounters.name: Troublemaker
encounters.description: One or more people are causing trouble for those around them and must be talked into scattering.

encounters.name: Veilstead
encounters.description: Arcane perception reveals a place concealed by supernatural means.

encounters.name: Vista
encounters.description: You reach a vantage point that gives you a heartening view of what lies ahead.

encounters.name: Warden
encounters.description: Someone has caught you trespassing, and you must deceive them into allowing you to remain.

encounters.name: Watcher
encounters.description: Someone keeps watch nearby, forcing you to pass without being noticed.

encounters.name: Wayward
encounters.description: Someone you need to bring with you refuses to come willingly.

encounters.name: Wild
encounters.description: You enter an untamed, inhospitable place that wears down your resolve.

encounters.name: Wonder
encounters.description: A strange animal can be noticed only by following a sudden magical pull on your perception.
